risk_if_not_implemented: Without Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM), security events may go undetected, allowing threats to persist and increasing breach dwell time.

compensating_control_1.name: Control Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Control Conformity Monitoring (CPL-03) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM) (CPL-03.8) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-01) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM) (CPL-03.8) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
